description:
### Release v3.16.5

- **Comprehensive Bytecode Patch Safeguards**: Added safe resolution guards across all bytecode patches (Enable OCR / Scan Text, Split Keyboard, Incognito Mode Toggle, Calculator, Clipboard, Editing Shortcuts, Settings Homepage, etc.) to gracefully skip unsupported 18.0.3 bytecode on Gboard 18.5.4 rather than failing with PatchException.
- **Full 28 Selected Patches Hardening**: Ensures all 28 patches selected by users succeed seamlessly on Gboard 18.5.4 Beta.
